designationHistory.indexText: The Nansemond National Wildlife Refuge was created when the Department of Defense transferred three tracts of tidal marsh on the Nansemond River in Suffolk, Virginia, to the Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Transfer of federal property from the Department of Defense
